name: speed_estimator_v3
role: Learned correction of integrated longitudinal acceleration, anchored at the last GNSS fix
training_data: 11 IO-VNBD drives with a VBOX vehicle-frame inertial recording (tools/iovnbd_to_contract.py)
protocol: leave-one-drive-out; vehicle-frame IMU input; VBOX speed as label only
limitations: Trained and evaluated on the VBOX vehicle-frame acceleration and yaw rate (external-IMU case), not on a phone IMU; the phone export in IO-VNBD is not a usable inertial signal.
Median drift is still above the 10 % gate (about 12 % over 30 s outages and 17 % over 60 s outages); only 25-43 % of outages are under 10 %.
Drift is a position built from this speed and a yaw-integrated heading starting at the true position, not the full engine; the engine arm 'ekf_nhc_v3' has not been evaluated yet.
Mostly UK roads and a few vehicles; no tunnel, urban-canyon or two-wheeler data; not run on a device or in a vehicle.
No vibration features: IO-VNBD is 10 Hz.
